notes:
What’s new in DriveDeck 0.20.2

• Martin: a new instrument cluster with analog speed and RPM scales, a smooth white gauge sweep and green arcs that follow the live readings.
• Switch Martin’s center display between cover art with a visualizer, maps, 3D maps and tire pressures. Fuel and engine temperature sit in the bottom of the dials.
• Martin hides the mini player while cover art is active and keeps its center selector reachable in fullscreen.
• Visualizer motion now has a 0–200% slider in Settings → Display, with a default of 100%.
• Exclude BeamNG audio from visualizers. Windows excludes the game’s process audio; Linux follows the music app shown in Now Playing.
• Updated companion adds live tire pressures when the vehicle supplies them. Reinstall the companion and restart BeamNG to enable this data.

Linux: AppImage, Debian and portable packages are included. AppImage users can update inside DriveDeck; other Linux packages update manually. Music-only capture still needs broader Linux desktop testing. Existing settings are preserved.
